definitions.explanation: Of the highest quality or rank.

examples.japanese: {一流|いちりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at a first-class hotel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一流|いちりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧だ。
{一流|いちりゅう}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to get a job at a top-tier company.

notes:
{一流|いちりゅう} describes something of the highest rank, quality, or caliber. It modifies nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or directly as a compound.

FORMS:
⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one, first) + {流|りゅう} (rank, class)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一流|いちりゅう}⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧: first-class hotel
- {一流|いちりゅう}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: top-tier company
- {一流|いちりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧: first-class chef
- {一流|いちりゅう}⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧: top university
- {一流|いちりゅう}⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧: top-class athlete

RANK SERIES:
- {一流|いちりゅう}: first-class, top tier
- ⟦{二流|にりゅう}→二流：15294_niryuu⟧: second-rate
- {三流|さんりゅう}: third-rate (often derogatory)

USAGE:
Always positive when used for {一流|いちりゅう}. ⟦{二流|にりゅう}→二流：15294_niryuu⟧ and {三流|さんりゅう} carry negative connotations. The word can describe people, places, institutions, or skills.
